description: Add a piece to a cart. Pass cart_id to reuse an existing cart (the durable handle), or omit it to start a fresh one. Call get_product first to get valid sizes/colours (or an exact variant_id); for a design sold in two fits (regular / oversize, priced apart) you MUST pass `fit`. size is required when the colour comes in more than one size: ask the buyer, never choose one for them. qty is capped at 20. Returns the cart_id and the server-side cart summary (VAT included where applicable). `region` (ISO-2) sets the ship-to country + currency of a NEW cart. A reused cart ships where it already ships: a `region` that disagrees with it is refused (start a new cart instead). If a reused cart has expired or was already checked out, a fresh one is made in the same region and the reply says cart_replaced: true.

cart_id.description: reuse this cart; omit to create a new one

colour.description: piece colour from get_product, e.g. black / white, or the name shown, e.g. Faded Black (default: the first colour you can buy where the cart ships)

fit.description: regular or oversize; REQUIRED when the design comes in both (get_product lists them)

handle.description: product handle (resolves a variant by size + colour; call get_product for valid values)

region.description: ISO-2 ship-to country for a NEW cart (e.g. se / us / de); with a cart_id it must match where that cart ships, or nothing is added

size.description: size label from get_product (it lists the sizes you can buy where the cart ships); required when the colour comes in more than one size, ask the buyer

variant_id.description: a specific variant id from get_product (overrides handle/size/colour)

name: add_to_cart
